settings_account_alert_credentials: The server no longer accepts the saved credentials. Generate a new authorization code or app password, then paste it under Update credentials.
settings_account_alert_error: The last connection attempt failed. Check the server settings or your network, then probe again.
settings_account_confirm_remove_body: Stops sending and receiving and deletes the managed credentials. Local mail is kept, and nothing is deleted from the server. Pending write-backs are not undone; resolve them in sync activity first.
settings_account_confirm_toggle_body: Local mail is kept. While paused, this account stops syncing in the background.
settings_account_credentials_see_list: See the account list for credential status
settings_account_editor_intro_edit: After changing connection details you can probe again. Saved passwords aren't shown.
settings_account_editor_intro_new: Enter your email address and common providers are set up automatically. Paste your authorization code, and connect once the probe passes.
settings_account_error_probe_required: Pass the incoming and outgoing probes before connecting this account.
settings_account_keychain_note: Credentials are stored only in the system keychain. After you close the window, mail keeps arriving quietly in the background with very little memory.
settings_account_plugin_note: Enter an address that already exists in the extension. Probing only reads remote state; it doesn't create a mailbox or save a binding.
settings_account_saved: {name} saved. The account list shows its connection status.
settings_accounts_empty_body: Connect an existing mailbox; no {product} account needed. Pick a provider and the setup fills in the servers for you.
settings_accounts_intro: Every mailbox, each in its place.
settings_accounts_note: Pausing sync keeps local mail. Before removing an account, you'll see exactly what happens to local data, credentials, and server mail.
settings_address_confirm_body: Only the local address record changes; the remote mailbox is not deleted. Existing drafts check the address again when sent.
settings_address_error_account_changed: The account for this address form changed. Cancel and fill it in again.
settings_address_error_account_gone: The account you were editing is no longer available. Cancel the address entry and choose an account again.
settings_address_error_days: Enter an expiry from 1 to 365 days, or leave it blank.
settings_address_error_primary_only: This account can currently send only from its primary address.
settings_address_form_address_hint: Leave blank to have the background service generate an address on the same domain; your provider must accept mail for it.
settings_address_form_days_hint: Leave blank to keep it forever. Expiry only disables the local identity.
settings_address_form_note: Registering doesn't create a remote alias. First make sure your provider accepts mail for this address and allows sending from it.
settings_address_registered: Sending identity registered locally. Make sure your server allows sending from this address.
settings_addresses_intro: Manage the local sending identities this mailbox can use.
settings_addresses_primary_only_note: This account currently supports only its primary address; local aliases can't be used for sending.
settings_appearance_density_hint: Comfortable uses 90px rows; compact uses 68px rows and hides previews.
settings_appearance_intro: Affects only this window; messages keep the sender's own layout and colors.
settings_appearance_theme_hint: Follow the system, or always use light / dark. Messages keep their original colors in the dark theme.
settings_connection_backup_note: Backup and restore need a separate maintenance procedure: stop the related processes, verify the candidate store, and keep a rollback record. This page has no switch that overwrites the mail store directly.
settings_connection_frontend_note: This window is a replaceable frontend package that connects to the background service under its own identity. What it can do is set by the permissions below; third-party frontends use the same list.
settings_connection_intro: After you close the window, the separate background service keeps receiving mail. Accounts and mail are stored on this computer; credentials are managed by the system credential store.
settings_connection_recovery_failed: Couldn't open recovery. Open Repair & Background from the full {app} app.
settings_connection_recovery_hint: Restore the built-in frontend, or start or stop the background service, in a separate native window.
settings_connection_recovery_offline: The background service isn't connected. Open recovery from {app}.
settings_error_connection_changed: The connection changed before the result was confirmed. Refresh to see the actual state, and don't submit again.
settings_error_generic: The action didn't finish. Refresh and try again.
settings_help_link_copied: Couldn't open the browser. Link copied: {url}
settings_help_link_open_manually: Open this link in your browser: {url}
settings_language_hint: Interface language. “Follow system” uses your system's preferred languages; the choice is stored by the background service and shared by every window.
settings_language_not_persisted: The language preference file can't be written, so the language can't be changed right now.
settings_language_unavailable: This version of the background service doesn't support a language preference, so the interface uses Simplified Chinese.
settings_leave_confirm_body: Unsaved account, rule, or address entries will be cleared. Saved mail and accounts don't change.
settings_leave_error_busy: An action is in progress. Wait for it to finish before leaving.
settings_notifications_denied_note: Allow notifications in macOS System Settings → Notifications → {product}, then refresh this page. Once denied, the system may not ask again.
settings_notifications_identity_mismatch: This development identity can't request notifications. Use a supported installer.
settings_notifications_intro: Decide when to be alerted and how much a notification shows.
settings_notifications_keywords_hint: One per line. Matching notifications don't alert you; mail is still received.
settings_notifications_mute_note: Checked accounts still receive mail; they just stop showing notifications.
settings_notifications_mute_profiles_una: The account list can't be read right now.
settings_notifications_mute_unsupported: The current background service doesn't support muting by account yet. Upgrade it to use this.
settings_notifications_new_mail: System notifications for new inbox mail
settings_notifications_new_mail_note: Shows a system notification when new mail arrives in the inbox. Verification codes still follow the sensitive content rule below.
settings_notifications_new_mail_unsuppor: The current background service doesn't offer this switch yet. Upgrade it to use this.
settings_notifications_requested: Permission requested. Follow the system prompt, then check the refreshed permission status.
settings_notifications_sensitive_note: Let notifications show sensitive content such as verification codes.
settings_notifications_unavailable: System notifications aren't available on this platform or background service.
settings_outgoing_secret_hint: The saved password isn't shown. Leave blank to keep it.
settings_page_offline: The background service isn't connected. You can view existing information, but management actions are unavailable.
settings_probe_advice_auth: The server rejected the sign-in. Check the username and password; many providers require an app password or authorization code.
settings_probe_advice_auth_provider: The server rejected the sign-in. {provider} needs your {credential}, not your web sign-in password. Make sure IMAP/SMTP is turned on, then generate a new one.
settings_probe_advice_capability: The server lacks capabilities {product} needs. Make sure your provider has IMAP turned on.
settings_probe_advice_connect: The server name resolves but the connection fails. Check the port, and make sure your network or proxy isn't blocking {protocol}.
settings_probe_advice_default: Check the connection settings and try again.
settings_probe_advice_dns: Can't find the {protocol} server. Check the server address spelling, or click Detect servers.
settings_probe_advice_mailbox: Signed in, but the incoming folder wasn't found. Check the Incoming folder setting (usually INBOX).
settings_probe_advice_provider: The mail provider extension isn't ready. Make sure it's enabled in Extensions.
settings_probe_advice_tls: The encryption handshake failed. Ports 993 / 465 usually use TLS; 143 / 587 usually use STARTTLS.
settings_provider_aliyun_step_1: In Alibaba Mail on the web, turn on IMAP under Settings → Account → POP3/SMTP and IMAP/SMTP
settings_provider_aliyun_step_2: Use your email sign-in password, or your separate client password if you set one
settings_provider_exmail_step_1: Use the full email address your company assigned you
settings_provider_exmail_step_2: If Secure Login is on, generate a password under Settings → Account → Client-Specific Password in Tencent Exmail and paste it here
settings_provider_exmail_step_3: Your administrator controls IMAP/SMTP access; if you can't connect, contact them
settings_provider_fastmail_step_1: In Fastmail, open Settings → Privacy & Security → App passwords
settings_provider_fastmail_step_2: Create a new password with IMAP and SMTP access and paste it here
settings_provider_gmail_step_1: Turn on 2-Step Verification for your Google Account first
settings_provider_gmail_step_2: Open Google Account → Security → App passwords and create one
settings_provider_gmail_step_3: Copy the 16-character password shown; the spaces are removed automatically
settings_provider_icloud_step_1: Turn on two-factor authentication for your Apple Account
settings_provider_icloud_step_2: At account.apple.com, open Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords and generate one
settings_provider_icloud_step_3: Paste the generated password; it is not your Apple Account password
settings_provider_netease_step_1: In NetEase Mail on the web, open Settings → POP3/SMTP/IMAP
settings_provider_netease_step_2: Turn on the IMAP/SMTP service and complete the phone verification it asks for
settings_provider_netease_step_3: Add an authorization password and paste it here; it is not your sign-in password
settings_provider_outlook_caveat: Microsoft no longer lets personal Outlook.com / Hotmail accounts sign in with a password in third-party apps; only OAuth is accepted. {product} doesn't support OAuth yet, so probing a personal account fails at the Authentication stage.
settings_provider_outlook_step_1: Microsoft 365 work or school account: ask your administrator to turn on IMAP and SMTP AUTH for you
settings_provider_outlook_step_2: If your organization allows app passwords, generate one under Microsoft account → Security and paste it here
settings_provider_proton_caveat: Bridge only serves on this computer at 127.0.0.1. If you changed its ports in Bridge settings, expand the connection settings and change them here too.
settings_provider_proton_step_1: Install Proton Mail Bridge on this computer and sign in (requires a paid plan)
settings_provider_proton_step_2: In Bridge's mailbox details, copy the IMAP/SMTP username and Bridge password
settings_provider_proton_step_3: Bridge must keep running for {product} to send and receive
settings_provider_qq_step_1: In QQ Mail on the web, open Settings → Account and Security → Security Settings
settings_provider_qq_step_2: Turn on the IMAP/SMTP service and complete the verification it asks for
settings_provider_qq_step_3: Generate an authorization code and paste it here; it is not your QQ password
settings_provider_yahoo_step_1: In Yahoo, open Account Info → Account Security
settings_provider_yahoo_step_2: Choose Generate app password, then copy and paste it here
settings_provider_zoho_step_1: In Zoho Mail, turn on IMAP under Settings → Mail Accounts → IMAP Access
settings_provider_zoho_step_2: If two-factor authentication is on, generate a password under Zoho Accounts → Security → App Passwords and paste it here
settings_quiet_hours_fixed_note: Calculated with the fixed UTC offset below; it doesn't change with daylight saving time.
settings_quiet_hours_follow_hint: Adapts automatically to the system time zone, daylight saving changes, and travel across time zones.
settings_quiet_hours_follow_note: Calculated in the system's local time zone, following daylight saving time and travel automatically.
settings_quiet_hours_offset_hint: For example, UTC+8 is 480 and UTC−5 is −300.
settings_quiet_hours_tz_mismatch: The configured fixed offset is {offset} ({minutes} minutes), which differs from the system time zone {systemOffset} ({systemMinutes} minutes).
settings_rules_applied_session: Rules applied for this background session only. After a restart, the rules from the config file apply again.
settings_rules_persisted: Rules are saved and stay in effect after the background service restarts.
settings_rules_persistence_unknown: The background service hasn't said whether rules are saved permanently; the save receipt will say.
settings_rules_session_only: Rules apply only while the background service keeps running. After a restart, the rules from the config file apply again.
settings_secret_hint_generic: Most providers require an app password or authorization code.
settings_secret_hint_provider: {provider} needs your {credential}, not your web sign-in password.
settings_secret_hint_saved: The saved password isn't shown. Leave blank to keep it when saving; enter it to probe again.
settings_server_idle: Use IMAP IDLE to receive new mail
settings_server_security_hint: Switching updates standard ports to match.
settings_wizard_discovered: Found {server}:{port}. Run a probe to confirm.
settings_wizard_error_address_required: Enter your full email address before detecting servers.
settings_wizard_guessed: Couldn't find the servers, so {incoming} / {outgoing} were filled in from common conventions. Check them, then run a probe.
settings_wizard_hint: Enter an address to recognize common providers such as QQ, NetEase, Gmail, and iCloud automatically.
settings_wizard_recognized: Recognized as {provider}. Server settings were filled in automatically.
settings_wizard_unknown_domain: {domain} isn't in the built-in provider list.
